environment.description: Deployed on EKS 1.28 with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Each pod runs with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class that intercepts all syscalls through its sentry process. The pod securityContext specifies readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with an emptyDir volume (medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 10Mi) mounted at /tmp scoped per-pod via the kubelet's per-pod tmpfs namespace. The container runs as UID 65534 (nobody). Additionally, the PostgreSQL 15 connection uses role 'app_tenant_reader' which has RLS enforced (no BYPASSRLS) with policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')). The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the RDS endpoint on port 5432. A Falco runtime rule (macro: open_write with condition: fd.name startswith /tmp AND proc.name = node) generates alerts but does NOT block writes to the pod-local /tmp.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network_policy: egress only to RDS endpoint:5432, deny all other
config.pod_isolation: per-pod mount namespace, no shared filesystem
